II. The Global River Cities Alliance (GRCA) is a unique alliance covering 275+ global river cities in 11 countries.
III. The Global River Cities Alliance (GRCA) is the first of its kind in the world.
Which of the above given statements is/are correct?
explanation: The Global River Cities Alliance (GRCA) was launched at COP28 in Dubai (UAE), NOT in New Delhi (making Statement I incorrect). It encompasses 275+ river cities across 11 partner countries (Statement II is correct). It is the world's first global alliance dedicated to sustainable river-centric urban development (Statement III is correct). Therefore, II and III only are correct.
whyCorrect: Statements II and III accurately convey the scope and unique global status of GRCA.

whyIncorrect.A: Statement I is false because COP28 was hosted in Dubai, UAE.
whyIncorrect.B: Statement I is false.
whyIncorrect.C: Statement I is false.

questionText: Which among the following is incorrectly paired?

options.text: Jagananna Chedodu : It provides a financial assistance of ₹ 10,000 per annum to Rajakas and Nayee Brahmins for better livelihood.
Jagananna Thodu : It facilitates a working capital loan up to ₹ 10,000 to the eligible poor, small and petty vendors with an intention to make them financially independent.
Jagananna Jeeva Kranthi Scheme : It aims to empower and provide social stability to women belonging to BC, SC and ST categories. The beneficiaries will receive sheep and goat units under this scheme.
YSR Navodayam Scheme : It aims to provide self-employment opportunities to the youth of Andhra Pradesh by creating job opportunities in the transport sector.

explanation: YSR Navodayam is a one-time restructuring scheme for stressed Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) in Andhra Pradesh to provide financial breathing room and recapitalization. In contrast, financial assistance for self-employed auto/taxi drivers in the transport sector is provided under the 'YSR Vahana Mitra' scheme. Thus, Option D is incorrectly paired.
whyCorrect: YSR Navodayam relates to MSME loan restructuring, not transport youth self-employment.

whyIncorrect.A: Jagananna Chedodu correctly provides ₹10,000/yr to Rajakas, Nayee Brahmins, and Tailors.
whyIncorrect.B: Jagananna Thodu correctly provides interest-free loans of ₹10,000 for street vendors.
whyIncorrect.C: Jagananna Jeeva Kranthi correctly distributes sheep/goat units to BC/SC/ST women.

questionText: The Centre of Excellence for Vegetables and Spices under the Indo-Israel Agriculture Project was proposed to be set up in:
explanation: Under the Indo-Israel Agriculture Project (IIAP), the Government established a Centre of Excellence (CoE) for Vegetables and Spices at Madhavaram in Palnadu district (formerly part of Guntur), utilizing Israeli micro-irrigation and protected cultivation techniques.
whyCorrect: Palnadu District is the official site of this Centre of Excellence.

whyIncorrect.A: Annamayya district is not the designated site.
whyIncorrect.B: Alluri Sitharamaraju is a tribal agency district not selected for this project.
whyIncorrect.D: While historically in undivided Guntur, the reorganized district site is Palnadu.

questionText:
Consider the following statements:
I. Vijayawada Railway Station was awarded the 'Green Railway Station' certification with the highest rating of Platinum by Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED), USA.
II. Vijayawada Railway Station is the first in the South-Central Railway (SCR) Zone to have bagged the Platinum rating.

explanation: Vijayawada Railway Station was awarded the Platinum rating by the Indian Green Building Council (IGBC), NOT by LEED USA (making Statement I incorrect). questionText:
Which among the following countries got membership into BRICS bloc with effect from 1 January, 2024?
I. Egypt
II. Argentina
III. Indonesia

explanation: At the 15th BRICS summit in Johannesburg, six nations were invited to join BRICS from January 1, 2024. Argentina's newly elected president Javier Milei declined the invitation, and Indonesia opted to defer its application. Hence, I, IV and V gained membership.
whyCorrect: Egypt, Ethiopia, and Saudi Arabia formally became full BRICS members on 1 January 2024.

whyIncorrect.A: Argentina (II) declined membership and Indonesia (III) did not join.
whyIncorrect.B: Both Argentina and Indonesia did not join.
whyIncorrect.C: Indonesia is not a member.

questionText:
Identify the incorrect statement regarding 'PM Vishwakarma Yojana' Scheme:
I. The Government of India launched the 'PM Vishwakarma Yojana' Scheme to provide end-to-end support to fishermen with non-mechanized boats.
II. 'PM Vishwakarma Yojana' Scheme provides collateral free enterprise development loan up to ₹ 6 lakhs in two tranches.
explanation: PM Vishwakarma was launched for traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 specified trades (e.g., carpenters, blacksmiths, potters, cobblers), not for fishermen (making I incorrect). whyIncorrect.B: Statement I is also incorrect.
whyIncorrect.D: Neither statement is correct.

questionText:

II. D.K. Chaduvula Babu was conferred with the Sahitya Akademi Bal Sahitya Puraskar 2023 in Telugu Language for his short stories 'Vajrala Vaana'.

whyIncorrect.A: Statement II is correct, so it cannot be part of the incorrect statements.
whyIncorrect.B: Statement II is correct.

questionText:
Identify the incorrect statements among the following:
I. Man Singh is the second Indian to win a gold medal at the Asian Marathon Championships.
II. Hardik Singh was named as Men's FIH Player of the Year at the International Hockey Federation Hockey Star Awards 2023.
III. Indian women's hockey captain Sushila Chanu won the FIH 'Best Goalkeeper of the Year Award' at the International Hockey Federation Hockey Star Awards 2023.

questionText: In which part of Andhra Pradesh is India's first largest private gold mine located?
explanation: India's first large private commercial gold mine is the Jonnagiri Gold Project, developed by Geomysore Services India / Deccan Gold Mines, situated at Jonnagiri in Tuggali Mandal of Kurnool District, Andhra Pradesh.
whyCorrect: Tuggali Mandal in Kurnool District is the precise administrative location of the Jonnagiri gold mine.

whyIncorrect.A: Krishnagiri is not the site of the Jonnagiri mine.
whyIncorrect.B: Aspari is an adjacent mandal but not where the gold deposit is sited.
whyIncorrect.D: Rudravaram is in Nandyal district.

questionText:
Consider the following statements about the Indira Gandhi Prize for Peace, Disarmament and Development for 2023:
I. Daniel Barenboim was announced as winner of the Indira Gandhi Prize 2023 for his efforts to solve economic crisis and his contribution in the development of Sri Lanka.
II. Ali Abu Awwad was announced as winner of the Indira Gandhi Prize 2023 for his efforts towards a non-violent resolution of the Israel-Palestine conflict.

whyIncorrect.A: Statement II is correct, so it cannot be marked incorrect.
whyIncorrect.B: Statement II is correct.
whyIncorrect.D: Statements I and III are clearly false.

questionText: Which among the following rare natural phenomenon is going to happen in 2024, after 221 years, in the United States of America?
explanation: In Spring 2024, two distinct broods of periodical cicadas—Brood XIX (the 13-year Great Southern Brood) and Brood XIII (the 17-year Northern Illinois Brood)—emerged simultaneously across parts of the Midwest and Southeast United States. This dual emergence occurs once every 221 years (13 × 17 = 221), last seen together in 1803.
whyCorrect: The simultaneous co-emergence of 13-year and 17-year periodical cicadas (221-year cycle) is the Double Cicada Explosion.

whyIncorrect.A: Fire tornadoes are localized wildfire whirls unrelated to a 221-year cyclical occurrence.
whyIncorrect.B: Glow worm caves are found predominantly in New Zealand.
whyIncorrect.C: Ice volcanoes occur irregularly on lakes and are not a 221-year periodicity event.

questionText:

II. Cleanest Ganga Town rank 2 : Varanasi

questionText: Priyanka brought 20 plates and 12 teacups. She marked up the plates by 15% on the cost price of each and the teacups by ₹ 20 on the cost price of each. explanation: Let CP of plate = p. Then CP of teacup = 0.60p. Selling price of plate = 1.15p, and selling price of teacup = 0.60p + 20. She sold 75% of 20 plates = 15 plates and 8 teacups. Profit on sold items = 15(1.15p - p) + 8((0.60p + 20) - 0.60p) = 15(0.15p) + 8(20) = 2.25p + 160 = 385 => 2.25p = 225 => p = ₹100. Thus, CP of plate = ₹100, CP of teacup = ₹60. Total cost incurred for all items = 20(100) + 12(60) = 2000 + 720 = ₹2,720. Total revenue from sold items = 15(115) + 8(80) = 1725 + 640 = ₹2,365. Overall result = 2,365 - 2,720 = -₹355 (Loss of ₹ 355).
whyCorrect: Total revenue (₹2,365) minus total cost (₹2,720) results in a net Loss of ₹ 355.

questionText: Mahesh and Krishna are engaged to do a work. Mahesh working alone takes 8 hours more to complete the job than if both worked together. If Krishna worked alone, he would need 4½ hours more to complete the job than if they both worked together. How much time would they both take to do the work together?
explanation: If two workers take 'a' and 'b' hours more than their combined time T to complete a task individually, the combined time is given by the formula T = √(a × b). Here a = 8 hours and b = 4½ hours = 9/2 hours. Therefore, T = √(8 × 9/2) = √36 = 6 hours.

whyIncorrect.A: 4.4 hours is an arithmetic miscalculation.
whyIncorrect.B: 5 hours is an erroneous estimate.
whyIncorrect.C: 5.3 hours is not the geometric mean.

Statement: Two industrialists, Shyam and Manoj, have industries right next to each other. They have been working hard for their industries' development and both of them manufacture the same product. Both spend equal amount of time, use the same materials and are equally hardworking. During the sales period, Shyam had better product sale in comparison to Manoj's product.
Conclusion I: The quality of material used by Manoj was not good.
Conclusion II: Power cuts ruined the quality of Manoj's product.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

explanation: Conclusion I directly contradicts the premise that both 'use the same materials', so it cannot follow. Conclusion II introduces an external unmentioned variable ('power cuts') that has no factual basis in the given statement. Hence, neither conclusion follows.
whyCorrect: Conclusion I is refuted by the premises, and Conclusion II is completely speculative.

whyIncorrect.A: Conclusion I contradicts the premise 'use the same materials'.
whyIncorrect.B: Conclusion II makes an unsupported leap without textual backing.
whyIncorrect.C: Neither conclusion is logically warranted.

questionText:
Statement: The civic authority has decided that all the factories located inside the city limits be shifted outside to reduce the level of environmental pollution in the city.
Assumption I: The pollution level in the city in future may reduce after these factories are shifted outside the city limits.
Assumption II: Enough usable land is available outside the city limit for these factories.
Assumption III: Many of these factories may shift to some other smaller towns to remain profitable.

options.text: Only I and II are implicit
Only II and III are implicit

explanation: When an authority decides to shift factories outside the city to reduce pollution: (1) It naturally assumes that relocating factories will effectively help reduce pollution in the city (Assumption I is implicit). (2) It assumes that adequate feasible land exists outside the city limits to accommodate the relocated factories, as an unfeasible move would not be decreed (Assumption II is implicit). (3) Moving to smaller towns is an extrinsic speculation regarding factory management decisions not assumed by the civic authority (Assumption III is not implicit). Therefore, only I and II are implicit.
whyCorrect: Assumptions I and II are necessary presuppositions for the civic authority's relocation directive.

whyIncorrect.A: Assumption II is also necessarily implicit for the policy to be executable.
whyIncorrect.C: Assumption I is the primary objective and directly implicit.
whyIncorrect.D: Assumption III is not presupposed by the civic body.
